<!--
Thanks for taking the time to suggest a feature! The more specific you are
about the *problem* (not just the solution you have in mind), the better
we can evaluate whether it belongs in the core project.
-->

## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

<!--
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when …" / "My use case is … and today I need to …"
-->

## Describe the solution you'd like

<!--
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Be specific
about the user-visible behaviour — not the code implementation.
-->

### Expected user flow

1. User opens '....'
2. User clicks '....'
3. The app does '....'
4. User sees '....'

## Describe alternatives you've considered

<!--
Is there a work-around today? What have you tried that doesn't quite fit?
Are there other ways to solve the same problem you want us to weigh against?
-->

## Why should this be in the core project?

<!--
Not all features belong in core — some things are better as a fork or a
user-level helper script. Help us understand why this is a common enough
use case to carry for all users:

- [ ] It benefits > 50% of users (not a very niche workflow)
- [ ] It has zero impact on users who don't use it (no extra JS weight when disabled)
- [ ] It fits the "fireworks simulator" scope (not an unrelated feature, e.g. a built-in chat)
- [ ] It is accessible without a mouse / works on touch devices
-->

## Rough scope / complexity estimate (for maintainers, fill if you can)

| Aspect                                  | Estimate                             |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Lines of code change                    | e.g. < 100 / 100–500 / > 500         |
| New files needed                        | e.g. 0 / 1–2 / many                  |
| Affects rendering loop?                 | yes / no (performance-critical path) |
| Touches physics constants?              | yes / no (1:1 port fidelity matters) |
| Requires new tests?                     | yes / no                             |
| Requires new UI strings / translations? | yes / no                             |

## Screenshots / mockups

<!--
If this is a UI change, even a rough Paint-style doodle or ASCII diagram
helps a lot. Drag-and-drop images directly into the GitHub text box.
-->

## Additional context

<!--
Add any other context, prior art, screenshots of similar features in
comparable apps, or references to external libraries we could leverage here.
-->
